title: Fan-in bound for the configuration circuit
statement: For every finite-state binary Turing machine $M$, natural number $n$, finite list of bit sources $\ell$, and time bound $T$, the configuration circuit built from $M,n,\ell,T$ is well formed and every gate reads at most two vertices. Here well formed means that each gate has no repeated argument and every NOT gate has exactly one argument.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over bits
$\ell$ is a finite list of bit sources
